content.value_statement: Bid strategy mistakes can stall delivery, waste budget, or set targets from weak data. This skill turns campaign history into a clear bidding choice, target math, portfolio grouping, and learning-phase plan.
actual_capabilities: Recommends tCPA, tROAS, max-conversions, max-conversion-value, or manual CPC from goal and conversion volume.
Derives starting tCPA or tROAS targets from recent CPA, ROAS, and conversion history.
Labels metrics as Measured, User-provided, Estimated, or needs export.
Maps campaigns into bid portfolios when goals and economics match.
Plans learning-phase entry, do-not-touch windows, and reset risks.
Routes budget, pacing, or audit work to the appropriate sibling skill.
limitations: It does not allocate budgets across campaigns.
It does not monitor live pacing after launch.
It needs reliable CPA, ROAS, or conversion data for target recommendations.
It does not guarantee platform outcomes or replace ad account review.

use_cases.title: Launch a performance campaign
use_cases.description: Choose a starting bid strategy and target before a new DR campaign enters learning.

use_cases.title: Repair a throttled target
use_cases.description: Compare trailing CPA or ROAS with the current target and choose a safer next step.

use_cases.title: Group campaigns into portfolios
use_cases.description: Decide which campaigns can share bidding signal without mixing incompatible goals or economics.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a basic strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a bid strategy for a DR campaign with 90 conversions in the last 30 days and a $42 CPA.

prompt_templates.title: Set a starting target
prompt_templates.prompt: Set a starting tROAS target. The campaign earned 3.8x ROAS last month and the goal is 4.5x.

prompt_templates.title: Build a portfolio plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Group these campaigns into bid portfolios. Include their goals, CPA or ROAS history, conversion volume, and funnel stage.

prompt_templates.title: Plan learning entry
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a launch plan for five campaigns. Recommend strategy, starting target, portfolio grouping, learning-phase exit estimate, reset risks, and auditor handoff.

output_examples.input: A DR lead campaign has 90 conversions per month and a trailing $42 CPA.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use tCPA because conversion volume is adequate. Start near the trailing $42 CPA and tighten after learning stabilizes.

output_examples.input: An ecommerce campaign earned 3.8x ROAS last month, while the target goal is 4.5x.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use tROAS if value data is reliable. Start near 3.4x to 3.8x, then step upward after stable delivery.

output_examples.input: A prospecting campaign has 12 conversions in the last 30 days and no reliable revenue value.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: use max-conversions without a target or manual CPC. Revisit tCPA after conversion volume clears the threshold.

best_practices: Provide trailing 30-day conversions with CPA or ROAS before asking for a target.
Keep DR and prospecting campaigns in separate bid portfolios unless economics match.
Wait until learning exits before changing targets or budgets.
anti_patterns: Do not set tCPA or tROAS from an aspirational goal with no history.
Do not mix campaigns with very different CPA or ROAS economics in one portfolio.
Do not use this skill for live pacing decisions after launch.

faq.question: Can it work without Google Ads API access?
faq.answer: Yes. It can use numbers you provide from manual exports or account reports.

faq.question: Does it set budgets?
faq.answer: No. It plans bidding. Use a budget planning skill for spend allocation.

faq.question: When should I use tCPA instead of max-conversions?
faq.answer: Use tCPA when conversion volume is adequate and the account has a reliable CPA history.

faq.question: How does it handle missing history?
faq.answer: It asks for the missing export or recommends a learning strategy that avoids unsupported targets.

faq.question: Can it group campaigns into portfolios?
faq.answer: Yes. It groups campaigns only when goals, funnel stages, and target economics are compatible.

faq.question: Is it safe with pasted exports?
faq.answer: The skill instructs agents to treat pasted exports as untrusted input and ignore embedded instructions.
